Let
\[
B_n=\int_{[0,1]^4}e^{-n(P^2+Q^2)}\,d\mathbf x,\qquad J_n=I_n(0).
\]
Then
\[
I_n(\lambda)=B_n\sinh\lambda+J_n,
\]
so the unique solution is
\[
\lambda_n=\operatorname{arsinh}\!\left(-\frac{J_n}{B_n}\right).
\]

First,
\[
\int_0^1\int_0^1 e^{-n(xy)^2}\,dx\,dy
=\int_0^1 e^{-np^2}(-\log p)\,dp.
\]
With \(t=\sqrt n\,p\),
\[
\int_0^1 e^{-np^2}(-\log p)\,dp
=n^{-1/2}\int_0^{\sqrt n}e^{-t^2}\left(\frac12\log n-\log t\right)dt
\sim \frac{\sqrt\pi}{4}n^{-1/2}\log n.
\]
Hence
\[
B_n\sim \frac{\pi}{16}n^{-1}(\log n)^2.
\]

Now set
\[
\delta=n^{-1/4},\qquad u=U_j,\qquad v=V_k.
\]
For \(P=n^{-1/4}2^{-j}u\), \(Q=n^{-1/4}2^{-k}v\), the product-density formula gives
\[
d\mathbf x=(-\log P)(-\log Q)\,dP\,dQ.
\]
The prefactor \(2^{j+k}\) cancels the Jacobian \(2^{-j-k}\), so the signed logarithmic weight is
\[
\sum_{j,k=0}^1(-1)^{j+k}
\left(\frac14\log n+j\log2-\log u\right)
\left(\frac14\log n+k\log2-\log v\right)
=(\log2)^2.
\]

Write
\[
d=u-v,\qquad r=uv,\qquad d=\sqrt\delta\,z,\qquad r=1+\delta y.
\]
Then \(s=\delta z^2\), and
\[
du\,dv=\frac{dr\,dd}{u+v}
=\delta^{3/2}\frac{dy\,dz}{\sqrt{4+\delta(4y+z^2)}}.
\]
Also
\[
\Phi_n^+=4+\delta^2\left(((1+z^2)y+z^2-2)^2+(z^2-1)^2\right),
\]
\[
\Phi_n^-=4+\delta^2\left(((1+z^2)y+z^2)^2+(z^2-1)^2\right),
\]
and
\[
A_n(u,v)=\delta^2\left((1+z^2)^2y^2+(-2+2z^4)y+z^4-2z^2-\frac32\right).
\]

Put
\[
a=1+z^2,\qquad b=z^2-1,\qquad x=ay+b.
\]
Then
\[
A_n=\delta^2\left(x^2-\frac52\right),
\]
and the exponential difference becomes
\[
e^{-4\sqrt n}e^{-b^2}
\left(e^{-(x-1)^2}-e^{-(x+1)^2}\right).
\]
The first three terms in the expansion of
\[
\frac1{\sqrt{4+\delta(4y+z^2)}}
=\frac12-\frac{\delta(4y+z^2)}{16}
+\frac{3\delta^2(4y+z^2)^2}{256}
-\frac{5\delta^3(4y+z^2)^3}{2048}+O(\delta^4)
\]
integrate to zero by parity and the Gaussian moment identity
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}x\left(x^2-\frac52\right)
\left(e^{-(x-1)^2}-e^{-(x+1)^2}\right)dx=0.
\]
The first nonzero contribution is the cubic term. Since only the \(x^3\)-part survives,
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}x^3\left(x^2-\frac52\right)
\left(e^{-(x-1)^2}-e^{-(x+1)^2}\right)dx=7\sqrt\pi.
\]
Therefore
\[
J_n\sim
-(\log2)^2 e^{-4\sqrt n}\delta^{3/2}\delta^2\delta^3
\frac{35\sqrt\pi}{32}
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-(z^2-1)^2}}{(1+z^2)^4}\,dz.
\]
That is,
\[
J_n\sim
-\frac{35\sqrt\pi}{32}(\log2)^2\mathcal D\,
n^{-17/8}e^{-4\sqrt n}.
\]

Thus
\[
\lambda_n\sim-\frac{J_n}{B_n}
\sim
\frac{35\sqrt\pi}{32}(\log2)^2\mathcal D\,
\frac{16}{\pi}
n^{-9/8}(\log n)^{-2}e^{-4\sqrt n}.
\]
Hence
\[
\lambda_n\sim
\frac{35(\log2)^2\mathcal D}{2\sqrt\pi}
n^{-9/8}(\log n)^{-2}e^{-4\sqrt n}.
\]

So the required constants are
\[
\boxed{\alpha=\frac98,\qquad \beta=2,\qquad c=4,\qquad
L=\frac{35(\log2)^2}{2\sqrt\pi}\mathcal D.}
\]
